title: RMCP
description: Search remote Model Context Protocol servers and tools discovered by BuiltWith, without an API key.
summary: Search remote Model Context Protocol servers and tools discovered by BuiltWith, without an API key.
offersHint: Search remote Model Context Protocol servers and tools discovered by BuiltWith, without an API key. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://rmcp.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_mcp_servers
toolsPreview.description: Search indexed remote MCP servers by intended task, capability, product, category, endpoint metadata, or associated tools.

toolsPreview.name: search_mcp_tools
toolsPreview.description: Search individual tool capabilities across every indexed MCP server and identify each matching parent server.

toolsPreview.name: get_mcp_server
toolsPreview.description: Get a complete structured server record, endpoints, tools, evidence-based trust, risks, warnings and install options.

toolsPreview.name: get_mcp_tool
toolsPreview.description: Get one tool schema, parent server, endpoint, availability, inferred risk and parent installation instructions.

toolsPreview.name: get_mcp_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Get stored transport, authentication, protocol, availability, latency, TLS, redirect and schema-change information for an indexed endpoint.

toolsPreview.name: get_install_instructions
toolsPreview.description: Generate client-specific, copyable installation instructions without embedding credentials.

toolsPreview.name: check_mcp_endpoint
toolsPreview.description: Return the most recently stored check for an indexed endpoint. This never scans an arbitrary URL.

toolsPreview.name: compare_mcp_servers
toolsPreview.description: Compare two to four known RMCP servers by capabilities, tools, auth, transport, evidence, risk, latency and installation complexity.
